sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.content: By accessing and using this platform, you agree to comply with these terms and conditions, as well as our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

sections.title: 2. User Rights
items: Service Access: Right to continuously access the platform as long as your account is active and compliant with these terms.
Features: Use of all tools available based on your access level, including the interactive heat map and incident reporting.
Privacy: Protection of your personal data according to applicable laws.

sections.title: 3. User Obligations
items: Proper Use: Use the platform lawfully, without defamatory, illegal, or rights-infringing content.
Accuracy: Responsibility for the truthfulness of information provided, especially in incident reports.
Security: Maintain credential confidentiality and be accountable for all activity under your account.

sections.title: 4. Usage Restrictions
items: Commercial Use: Unauthorized commercial use of the platform or data is prohibited.
Unauthorized Access: Attempting to access restricted areas is not allowed.
Interference: Actions that affect performance or availability are forbidden.

sections.title: 5. Provider Responsibilities
items: Availability: Maintain platform operations, notifying users of scheduled maintenance.
Data Protection: Apply technical and organizational security measures.
Support: Provide technical support through established channels.

sections.title: 6. Provider Limitations
items: Account Suspension: Right to suspend or delete accounts that breach these terms.
Modifications: Ability to temporarily update or restrict features due to maintenance.

sections.title: 7. Intellectual Property
sections.content: All rights to the platform, its design, and content belong exclusively to the service provider. Unauthorized reproduction is prohibited.

sections.title: 8. Limitation of Liability
items: Not responsible for indirect damages or data loss.
Not responsible for service interruptions due to external factors.

sections.title: 9. Modifications
sections.content: These terms may be updated periodically. Continued use after updates implies acceptance.
